## What's new
- **Air Traffic leaves the Dock after setup.** Once the first-launch setup was closed, Air Traffic stayed in the Dock and in ⌘⇥ until it was next started, and came forward there every time a link was clicked. It now goes back to the menu bar as soon as setup closes. - **Keyboard shortcuts no longer open the ⌥ menu.** A launcher shortcut that holds ⌥ along with ⌘ or ⌃ — a Hyper key, for instance — opened the manual override menu instead of the link, and dismissing it opened nothing. The menu now opens only for ⌥ on its own (or ⇧⌥), as on a click.
